name: Outscraper
summary: Google Maps places and reviews, Google Search, website contacts, company firmographics and Amazon products from Outscraper's scraping API.

api_key.description: An Outscraper API key (app.outscraper.com > API key). Sent in the X-API-KEY header.

notes: Calls are asynchronous by default: they return {id} and the results come from requests.get, usually within 1-3 minutes. Pass async=false to wait for the results in the same call (best with small limits).
Results stay available for 4 hours after a request completes; then its status reads Pending again.
Most endpoints batch: repeat query (query=a&query=b, up to 1000) and results come back as one list per query.
Usage is counted per item returned (place, review...); a search that finds nothing still uses one item. Average throughput is about 20 queries a second.
Tasks (UI jobs), the business catalog and the other ~90 site scrapers (Yelp, Trustpilot, Indeed, Zillow...) are not in this entry; DELETE /requests/{id} terminates a request.

endpoints.name: Search Google Maps places
endpoints.summary: Places from Google Maps for a query such as 'bars, NY, USA', with optional contact enrichment.

query.description: What you would type in Google Maps, ideally with a location; or a google_id, place_id or CID. Repeat for a batch.

limit.description: Places per query, at most 500 (Google's own cap). 10 gives the fastest answer.

skipPlaces.description: Skip the first N places, a multiple of 20, for paging.

dropDuplicates.description: Merge results of several queries into one deduplicated list. Default false.

language.description: Language code, e.g. en (default), de, fr.

enrichment.description: Extra paid enrichments, e.g. leads_n_contacts (emails, social links, phones from the website).

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. query,name; all by default.

async.description: true (default) only submits the request and returns an id for requests.get; false keeps the connection open until results are ready.

notes: Put the location in the query: Outscraper's servers may sit in another country.

endpoints.name: Get Google Maps reviews
endpoints.summary: Reviews of the places a query or a place id finds, with the places' details.

query.description: A search (places from it) or one place by name, google_id, place_id or CID.

reviewsLimit.description: Reviews per place; 0 is unlimited. Default 100; 10 gives the fastest answer.

limit.description: Places to take from the query. Default 1.

reviewsQuery.description: Only reviews matching this text, e.g. 'amazing | great'.

cutoff.description: Oldest review timestamp to return; forces sort newest.

lastPaginationId.description: review_pagination_id of the last review received, to page on.

language.description: Language code, e.g. en (default), de, fr.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. query,name; all by default.

async.description: true (default) only submits the request and returns an id for requests.get; false keeps the connection open until results are ready.

query.description: The query; repeat for a batch of up to 1000.

tbs.description: Date range: past hour, day, week, month or year.

language.description: Language code, e.g. en (default), de, fr.

fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. query,name; all by default.

async.description: true (default) only submits the request and returns an id for requests.get; false keeps the connection open until results are ready.
